content.text: Surrounded. Punch the one at south (winding up).
Fighting the fodder enemies one at a time to build a debris pile.
Two winding up north. Kick north.
Enemy behind (south) winding up. Kick south.
Nearly dead; one last attack on the close winding-up enemy.

I died in box 1 without escaping any boxes. I got 4–5 kills, and the run ended after about 27 game seconds. Fodder enemies kept hitting me for 8 or 16 at a time while I was boxed in. By the end I was down to 4 HP, and the kick that would have killed me was the last action. The debris from kills was too sparse to build a ramp. I used about 25 of the 80 calls.
